frozen_baseline.guard: Ready + current exact approval receipt; plan bound approved_source to approved spec; allowed authority profile
frozen_baseline.effects: Append approval, increment revision, render and journal artifact.
frozen_baseline.failure_retry: Generic approve refuses sprint_pair/SMARTS profiles; invalid/stale receipt never changes state.

guard: approve resolves the actual spec for a plan, requires approved_source and authority.Approved on that spec, then validate.Ready and authority.Load/Subject for the exact artifact norm/ID/approval. The closed event/profile loader verifies actual retained chain rather than caller labels.
effects: Clone current document, set governance approved, append ApprovalRecord (old approvals retained), revision+1, render.Prepare then engine.save -> checked journal Commit.
failure_retry: sprint_pair and smarts_workflow expressly refuse the generic path. Invalid, unavailable or stale loaded subject returns before clone/save; Run checks exact plan revision AND model CAS and same-ID replay first.

frozen_baseline.guard: valid closed changes alter normative hash
frozen_baseline.effects: Keep historical approvals; revision advances; surviving execution progress preserved.
frozen_baseline.failure_retry: CAS and structural errors refuse whole batch.

guard: Closed changesType and CheckRequest reject unrecognized request shapes; Changes clones and applies only typed mutations. Normative hash change is assessed on fully prepared model.
effects: syncExecution retains live surviving task/prerequisite state/evidence, clone retains approval history, revision+1; changed NormHash sets governance draft and re-prepares. RequiredVersion preserves newer feature labels, not a rollback to0.3.2.
failure_retry: CAS happens before Changes; duplicate/kind/references/schema/structural failures return before engine.save. Full cloned batch becomes one journaled artifact save only after successful Prepare.

frozen_baseline.effects: Increment model revision/hash only; normative identity unchanged.

guard: rebrand is a CAS mutation. Name is1..120 chars and MIME is a closed SVG/PNG/JPEG enum. Local logo read is capped256KiB; Logo validates bounded raster dimensions or static SVG (no external resource/script/entity/style/event).
effects: Clone changes only presentation name/logo metadata, advances revision and model hash, then Prepare/save. Normative projection and governance/approval history are not assigned by rebrand.
failure_retry: No capture/approval event or authority receipt is minted. Invalid brand/path/content or Prepare/Commit failure remains refusal; original operation replay identity is owned by Run/store.

frozen_baseline.event: approval chain unavailable or subject changes
frozen_baseline.effects: Expose derived authority status without rewriting stored progress.
frozen_baseline.failure_retry: Strict authority consumers reject; ordinary progress can remain available.

guard: Approved requires stored approved state plus an approval record matching exact artifact and current NormHash; it reloads and verifies source hash, authority kind and Subject.
effects: Status derives authority_verified and diagnostic from Approved without mutation; old stored approved state, progress, receipts and reasons remain intact.
failure_retry: Strict guards reject absent/mismatched/current-unverified chain. Ordinary eligible/recordWork inspect structural/progress state without approval-chain authority, do not manufacture current verification.

frozen_baseline.guard: valid collection; ID never active/retired/allocated in same batch
frozen_baseline.effects: Add stable record; sync execution for new tasks/prerequisites; increment revision.
frozen_baseline.failure_retry: ID reuse rejected; whole batch atomic.

guard: Mutable collection map or criterion/scenario nested owner only; symbol.Build detects invalid/duplicate/max IDs, reserved/observed maps retain all pre-existing/tombstone/new nested IDs throughout batch; allocated IDs skip them.
effects: Add real stable record to cloned normative collection; syncExecution initializes only newly live task/prerequisite defaults and retains survivors; one revision/Prepare/save.
failure_retry: Reintroduction and ID/kind change refuse across intermediate indexes as well as final state. No partial batch is saved on error.

frozen_baseline.guard: same immutable ID/kind; exact permitted fields or permutation
frozen_baseline.effects: Change fields/order; semantic validation then one journaled artifact save.
frozen_baseline.failure_retry: Kind/ID edits, dangling references or invalid reorder refuse.

guard: record.update finds active immutable ID and forbids id assignment; interim/final indexes refuse kind/retirement changes. record.reorder accepts mutable symbol collection and an exact one-of-each existing-ID permutation.
effects: Only cloned record fields/collection order change; schema and structural validation including active references occurs in render.Prepare before one journaled save.
failure_retry: Absent/retired ID, kind drift, missing/duplicate/foreign permutation and dangling reference return before save. Tombstone read-only/closed model constraints remain.

frozen_baseline.guard: reason supplied; references remain valid; no conflicting orphan execution state
frozen_baseline.effects: Remove live record; append immutable tombstone with retiring revision/replacement.
frozen_baseline.failure_retry: Missing reason, tombstone editing, invalid replacement or dangling links refuse. Retiring tasks with check history currently fails due to N-F10.

guard: record.retire requires active non-singleton owner, reason and structurally valid replacement/references. Every removed descendant needs explicit reason; original kind is captured from the actual pre-removal symbol index.
effects: Append immutable tombstone with exact ID, next revision, reason/replacement and original_kind. Version0.3.4 permits correctly typed historical task checks/checkpoint baselines; live execution/scheduling uses only active records. History is retained rather than deleted to avoid ORPHAN_STATE.
failure_retry: Reason/immutable tombstone/replacement/dangling-reference guards persist. Frozen last sentence that checked-task retirement fails due to N-F10 is explicitly superseded by accepted NT-05 and maintained N06:03/N-F10 candidate_contract_note; no literal equality with that old bug is claimed.
authorized_change: NT-05 typed retirement and retained historical execution ownership; existing N06:03 TESTED proof/history remains unmodified, not renewed by this source review.

frozen_baseline.effects: Reject resurrection or rewriting historical identity.
frozen_baseline.failure_retry: New logical record must use new ID.

guard: Symbol.Build indexes retired IDs alongside active IDs; Changes reserves them and rejects record.add reuse, update/retire of retired records, or kind/retired-status changes.
effects: Tombstone cannot be removed/replaced to resurrect a logical identity. New logical record must use a genuinely unallocated ID.
failure_retry: IMMUTABLE_ID/IMMUTABLE_TOMBSTONE/DUPLICATE_ID/SYMBOL_NOT_FOUND are errors before save. Typed original_kind only extends retained history ownership, never authorizes identity reuse.

frozen_baseline.guard: same-slug Ready pair; exact spec_expected CAS when explicit draft mode
frozen_baseline.effects: Bind current spec digest; preserve execution/history; plan governance remains/resets draft, revision advances.
frozen_baseline.failure_retry: Concurrent source change or invalid pair refuses; no source approval invented.

guard: Explicit draft_preview shape requires spec_expected revision and model hash. bind resolves actual spec, exact same-slug canonical existing pair, Ready source; after Changes/clone it requires Ready next plan/binding.
effects: Set current spec ID/NormHash and draft_preview, set governance draft, revision+1, Prepare/save; clone preserves surviving work/history and approvals. No source approval is created.
failure_retry: Source CAS/pair/kind/Ready/binding failure refuses before save. Optional supplied changes still go through full Changes validation; original plan CAS and journal replay remain.

frozen_baseline.guard: valid current spec; actual authority assessed
frozen_baseline.effects: Choose approved_source only when genuine source approval valid; preserve work state.
frozen_baseline.failure_retry: No approval receipt required just to rebind ordinary plan.

guard: Default bind requires actual spec structural validity and valid resulting Binding, not a fresh approval to perform ordinary maintenance. It independently assesses authority.Approved on the selected source.
effects: Default mode begins draft_preview and becomes approved_source only after genuine exact current source approval succeeds; current source digest is recorded and existing work/history retained.
failure_retry: Failed authority lookup cannot become approved_source, and is not a reason to require a new grant merely for ordinary bind. No silent source approval, progress reset or stop clearing.

frozen_baseline.effects: Advisory consumers report binding_current=false; strict Ready/authority consumers reject.
frozen_baseline.failure_retry: Task-start and ordinary reporting do not silently rebind or auto-clear stop.

guard: Normative source changes yield a different model.NormHash; eligible and taskContext compare actual selected spec hash against the stored bound hash without changing the binding.
effects: Advisory eligible/task context report binding_current=false with recorded progress and reasons intact; validate.Binding/Ready and strict guards reject stale exact binding.
failure_retry: recordWork task-start changes only a genuinely PENDING task and never rebinds source or clears an existing stop. Ordinary advice is not strict evidence; strict consumption remains separate.
